d: Ajay Mitchell delivered a career night, erupting for a career-high 35 points on 14-20 shooting, knocking down 4 three-pointers and dishing out 5 assists to lead the Oklahoma City Thunder to a 128-97 victory over the Memphis Grizzlies. Mitchell scored a career-high 21 points on 9-11 shooting in the first half alone, marking his second career 30-point performance, with both coming this season. The Thunder improve to 7-2 overall and 1-0 in West Group B play, while the Grizzlies fall to 6-3 overall and 0-1 in group play.
